shots.reason: Establish the 6 Kilo morning setting and the daily ritual of father and son leaving home together.
shots.narration_am: በስድስት ኪሎ ጠዋት ላይ ከአባቴ ጋር በእግር መሄድ የቀኔ መጀመሪያ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: Walking with my father in the morning in Six Kilo was the start of my day.
shots.tts_style: Warm, calm, nostalgic, unhurried storytelling pace
shots.keyframe_prompt: Wide establishing shot of an Ethiopian father in a tweed blazer with a leather satchel and his 10-year-old son in a blue school sweater walking side by side down a tree-lined street in 6 Kilo Addis Ababa at sunrise, soft morning mist
shots.motion_prompt: Camera gently tracks alongside father and son walking slowly forward down the sunlit street, soft breeze moving eucalyptus leaves

shots.reason: Show the physical proximity of the school and university that shaped their shared route.
shots.narration_am: ቤታችን ቅርብ ስለነበር፣ እኔ ወደ ምስካየ ኅዙናን መድኃኔዓለም ትምህርት ቤት ስሄድ፣ እሱ ደግሞ ወደ ሚያስተምርበት ዩኒቨርሲቲ አብረን እንጓዝ ነበር።
shots.narration_en: Because our home was close by, as I headed to Miskaye Hizunan Medhanialem School and he walked toward the university where he lectured, we traveled together.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Medium shot of the Ethiopian father and 10-year-old son walking past historic stone walls and tall trees near a school gate and university campus avenue in Addis Ababa, morning sunlight filtering through branches
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle dolly-in as the father gestures ahead toward the campus avenue while walking beside his son, natural subtle step motion

shots.reason: Reframe the walk from a simple commute into an informal outdoor classroom.
shots.narration_am: የጠዋቱ የእግር መንገድ ለእኔ የትምህርት ክፍል ነበር። አባቴ እንግሊዝኛዬን እና የሂሳብ ችሎታዬን ለማሳደግ ሁልጊዜ ይጥር ነበር።
shots.narration_en: The morning walk was a classroom for me. My father always strove to build my English and mathematics skills.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Medium close-up of the Ethiopian father looking down with a warm encouraging smile at his 10-year-old son as they walk together, soft morning golden rim light on their faces
shots.motion_prompt: Father turns his head slightly toward his son and speaks warmly, son nods attentively, subtle handheld walk motion

shots.reason: Illustrate the spoken English practice happening naturally in conversation.
shots.narration_am: በአንዳንድ ቀናት በእንግሊዝኛ እያወራን ቃላትን እና አነጋገርን እንለማመዳለን።
shots.narration_en: On some days we spoke in English, practicing vocabulary and pronunciation as we walked.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Medium two-shot at eye level of the 10-year-old Ethiopian boy speaking animatedly with a confident smile while his father listens intently and nods along the sunlit sidewalk
shots.motion_prompt: The boy gestures lightly with one hand while speaking, father smiles and replies gently, slow pan matching their stride

shots.reason: Capture the mental math problem-solving beat and the visual motif of numbers on the walk.
shots.narration_am: በሌሎች ቀናት ደግሞ በእግር እየተራመድን የሂሳብ ጥያቄዎችን በአእምሮ እንፈታለን፤ ቁጥሮች ከጎዳናው ጋር የሚተሳሰሩ ይመስል ነበር።
shots.narration_en: On other days, we solved math problems in our heads while walking; it felt as if numbers were woven right into the street.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Close-up of the 10-year-old Ethiopian boy looking upward thoughtfully, counting on his fingers slightly while walking, dappled morning sunlight and soft geometric shadows on the stone pavement behind him
shots.motion_prompt: Slow push-in toward the boy's thoughtful face as his eyes brighten with an answer, gentle breeze in his hair

shots.reason: Bridge childhood walks to the present-day data science career through a visual transition.
shots.narration_am: ያኔ ቀላል የመሰሉኝ ጥያቄዎች እና የጠዋት ውይይቶች ዛሬ በዳታ ሳይንስ ዓለም ውስጥ መሠረት ሆነውኛል።
shots.narration_en: Those morning conversations and questions that seemed simple back then became my foundation in the world of data science today.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Medium shot of an Ethiopian data scientist in his late 20s seated beside a window in morning sunlight, looking at clean charts and Python data models on a laptop screen, warm wood desk
shots.motion_prompt: Camera slowly pushes in over the shoulder toward the glowing data visualizations on the laptop screen as morning light shifts gently

shots.reason: Connect pattern recognition and calm problem-solving to competing on an international stage.
shots.narration_am: በመረጃ ውስጥ ንድፍ መፈለግ፣ በትዕግስት ማሰብ እና በዓለም አቀፍ መድረክ በራስ መተማመን መወዳደር የጀመርኩት ከዚያ የጠዋት ጉዞ ነው።
shots.narration_en: Finding patterns in data, thinking patiently, and competing with confidence on the international stage all began on that morning walk.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Close-up insert of hands resting near a laptop keyboard beside a notebook with neat mathematical sketches and a cup of Ethiopian coffee, soft morning light illuminating dust motes
shots.motion_prompt: Subtle camera tilt up from the handwritten math notes toward the glowing laptop screen, soft steam rising from the coffee cup

shots.reason: Show the emotional continuity of carrying the father's voice into present-day work.
shots.narration_am: ዛሬ በዳታ እና በኮድ ስራ መካከል ስሆን፣ የስድስት ኪሎ ጠዋት ነፋስ እና የአባቴ የማያቋርጥ ጥያቄዎች አብረውኝ ይጓዛሉ።
shots.narration_en: Today, surrounded by data and code, the morning breeze of Six Kilo and my father's endless questions still walk beside me.
shots.keyframe_prompt: Medium close-up of the Ethiopian data scientist in his late 20s looking out the window into the early morning light with a calm grateful smile, warm golden light across his face
shots.motion_prompt: Gentle slow push-in as he turns slightly toward the window light, subtle natural breathing and calm expression

shots.reason: Close the film with the core takeaway and visual motif of steady footsteps forward.
shots.narration_am: ትልቅ ራዕይ በትንሽ እርምጃ ይጀምራል። ይህ ፊልም በኤአይ ተዘጋጅቷል።
shots.narration_en: Small steps begin great visions. This film was made with AI.
shots.tts_style: Clear, concise, gently brisk closing delivery
